## 更新内容 / Changes

- 修复复制本机 Codex / 兼容工具历史时，临时目录和工作树的无关文件触发 10 万项限制的问题。扫描时直接跳过顶层临时文件、缓存、日志、运行状态与工作树目录，保留会话、归档、索引、项目分组和其他配置资料。
- 工作树项目继续使用原项目路径，保留项目名称、顺序、固定项和会话归属，避免复制后指向不存在的项目目录。副本独立保存后续对话，原实例和原目录保留。
- 修复 CLI 退出瞬间进程参数已消失而导致停止失败的问题：恢复配置前再次核对进程身份；仍在运行且身份不符的进程继续保留，不发送终止信号。
- 保留取消、来源身份和内容变化检查，以及复制前后关闭来源客户端的检查。若模型目录或会话数据库配置依赖被跳过的目录，明确提示并拒绝创建不完整副本。

- Fixed local Codex / compatible-tool history copies failing the 100,000-entry limit because temporary files and project checkouts were included. Scans now prune top-level temporary, cache, log, runtime-state and worktree directories while retaining sessions, archives, indexes, project membership and other profile data.
- Worktree projects retain their original project paths, names, ordering, pinned items and thread assignments. Copies save subsequent conversations independently and preserve the original instance and directory.
- Fixed CLI stop failures when process arguments disappear during exit. Process identity is rechecked before configuration recovery; live mismatched processes remain untouched.
- Retained cancellation, source identity and change detection, and checks that the source client is closed before and after copying. Configured model catalogues or session databases inside excluded directories produce an explicit error rather than an incomplete copy.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）DMG / ZIP 和 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。结束运行中的实例并退出管理器后，再安装新版；已有账号、实例与本地配置保留。安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证，应用内自动更新尚未接入。

DMG and ZIP installers are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Finish running instances and quit the manager before replacing it; existing accounts, instances and local settings are retained. Developer ID signing, notarization and in-app automatic updates are not included.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

当前支持 Codex，客户端需单独安装。Claude Code、Claude Desktop 和其他客户端为计划功能，尚未接入。复制历史不会创建项目代码的独立副本；项目继续使用原文件目录。

Codex is currently supported and must be installed separately. Claude Code, Claude Desktop and other clients are planned, not implemented. Copying history does not duplicate project code; projects continue to use their original directories.
